title: I Pretended to Drown in Front of My Golden Retriever 😱
description:
I pretended to fall into the pool and struggle in the water to see how Ozzy would react. Would my Golden Retriever try to help me, call for someone, or simply watch from the side?

Watch until the end to see what he did! 🐶💦

This was filmed as a controlled scene with safety precautions.
